title: origanum vulgare var. albiflorum
intro: Origanum vulgare var. albiflorum, commonly known as White Flowered Oregano, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of White Flowered Oregano include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
